description: Part-round law under ALL-IN-TURN; one sweep moves every part once (parts made during the sweep wait for the next). After each sweep: members, parts, sorted h over members, sorted sizes of the inclusion-maximal met sets of the whole roster; for the sweep: births, total fresh distinctions f (usable and barred), sorted list of births as [number of parents, f]. 'fresh_usable_total' and 'moves' are extra.
